process_area.title: Lease Booking, Billing & Asset Lifecycle Management

fields.Participants: Lease Operations Mgr, Finance, IT, Treasury (links to VS-18)

workflows.name: Lease Booking, Asset Capitalization & Start-Day Setup

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Lease Operations Mgr book lease in lease-management system" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconcile to GL" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-schedule of "schedule" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-518 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Booking, Billing & Asset Lifecycle Management (PA-96.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Booking-error risk**: Wrong terms / schedule cause chronic billing issues; mitigated by 4-eyes booking review
System Touchpoints: - Lease management system; GL/FA (links to VS-17/VS-35); treasury (links to VS-18); billing (links to W3170)

steps.activity: Lease Operations Mgr book lease in lease-management system: contract terms, payment schedule, asset record (serial, location, customer), residual, end-of-term option, lessor (W3165), funding source; generate lease ID

Finance capitalize asset / record lease receivable per lease type (operating vs. finance lease per PFRS 16, which superseded PAS 17 — links to VS-17); post advance rental receipt and initial direct cost; reconcile to GL

Treasury (links to VS-18) confirm funding draw (if lessor-funded) or BuildRight warehouse line; disburse to vendor; activate billing schedule (links to W3170); confirm start day and first billing date

fields.Participants: Lease Operations Mgr, AR (links to VS-16), Finance, Treasury (links to VS-18)

workflows.name: Lease Billing Cycle, Auto-Debit & AR Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "generates monthly rental invoice per lease" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "file" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-monitor of "AR monitor aging" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-518 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Booking, Billing & Asset Lifecycle Management (PA-96.2).)
- operational: PDC back-up and proactive outreach
Pain Points / Risks: - **Collection-failure risk**: Auto-debit fails disrupt cash flow; mitigated by PDC back-up and proactive outreach
System Touchpoints: - Billing engine; AR/cash application (links to VS-16); auto-debit (links to VS-18); e-invoicing (links to VS-79)

steps.activity: System generates monthly rental invoice per lease: rental amount, VAT (W3183), other charges (insurance, maintenance if bundled); deliver to customer per preference (email, portal, e-invoice — links to VS-79)
AR (links to VS-16) process collection: auto-debit (ADA) via customer-bank mandate, online transfer, PDC (post-dated cheques) on file; apply cash; manage exceptions (failed debit, NSF cheque)
AR monitor aging; flag past-due to delinquency workflow (W3174); reconcile customer ledger; report portfolio billing metrics (on-time collection %, average days-past-due)

fields.Participants: Lease Operations Mgr, Field Service (links to VS-12), Quality, Customer, Insurance (links to VS-26)
fields.Trigger: Lease term; periodic inspection; maintenance schedule

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Lease Operations Mgr maintain asset record" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-schedule of "scheduled maintenance per contract" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "document with photos" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Asset-abuse risk**: Customer misuse accelerates depreciation; mitigated by inspection and maintenance contract
System Touchpoints: - Asset master (links to VS-35); field service (links to VS-12); telematics/monitoring (links to VS-70/VS-06)

steps.activity: Lease Operations Mgr maintain asset record: location, condition, hours/usage (where telematics available), maintenance history, serial; track moves between sites with customer notification

Field Service (links to VS-12) / Vendor perform scheduled maintenance per contract (BuildRight-managed or customer-managed); capture service records; for solar/storage (links to VS-70), leverage remote monitoring (W2542-style)

Lease Operations Mgr conduct periodic inspection (annual or per contract): asset condition, misuse, unauthorized modification, insurance compliance; document with photos; flag issues for remediation (W3172) or default path (W3174)

fields.Participants: Lease Origination Mgr, Lease Operations Mgr, Finance, Legal, Customer
fields.Trigger: Customer request; technology refresh; contract amendment

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validate credit impact" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-schedule of "schedule, residual adjustment, fees, taxes" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "Lease Operations Mgr book modification" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-518 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Booking, Billing & Asset Lifecycle Management (PA-96.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mod-error risk**: Mis-booked modification causes downstream issues; mitigated by 4-eyes review and audit trail
System Touchpoints: - Lease management system; pricing (links to W3162); contract amendment (links to VS-22/VS-30)

steps.activity: Lease Origination Mgr assess modification request: upgrade (new asset swap), add-on (additional asset under same contract), term extension, re-pricing; validate credit impact (links to W3163) and residual impact (links to W3162)
Finance/Lease Origination re-price: new payment schedule, residual adjustment, fees, taxes; Lease Credit Mgr re-approve if exposure increase; Legal execute amendment
Lease Operations Mgr book modification: update schedule, asset record (swap-in/out — links to W3175 for returned asset); communicate new terms; archive amendment

fields.Participants: Lease Operations Mgr, Insurance (links to VS-26), Customer, Legal, Finance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-report of "Customer reports damage/theft" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-inspect of "inspection" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "records" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-518 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Booking, Billing & Asset Lifecycle Management (PA-96.2).)
- operational: mandatory insurance verification (W3168) and annual check (W3171); operational: insurance verification (W3168) and annual check (W3171)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Uninsured-loss risk**: Coverage gap leaves BuildRight exposed; mitigated by mandatory insurance verification (W3168) and annual check (W3171)
System Touchpoints: - Insurance (links to VS-26); claim module; lease accounting (links to W3169/VS-17)

steps.activity: Customer reports damage/theft; Lease Operations Mgr capture incident with evidence (photos, police report for theft); confirm coverage per insurance policy (W3168)
Insurance Coordinator (links to VS-26) file claim with insurer; coordinate adjuster inspection; obtain repair/replacement authorization; manage deductible (customer or BuildRight per contract)

On settlement: Finance reconcile insurer payout, customer liability (deductible, uninsured loss), and lease balance; repair or replace asset (links to W3172) or settle lease (links to W3176); update asset/insurance records

fields.Participants: Lease Credit Mgr, AR (links to VS-16), Legal, Customer Service, Field Recovery

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-escalate of "escalate per timeline" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "For viable customers" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-file of "file collection suit, report to credit bureau" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-518 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Booking, Billing & Asset Lifecycle Management (PA-96.2).)
- operational: voluntary-surrender negotiation and legal process
Pain Points / Risks: - **Repossession difficulty risk**: Self-help repossession constrained by Philippine law; mitigated by voluntary-surrender negotiation and legal process
System Touchpoints: - AR/collections (links to VS-16); legal/case management; asset recovery

steps.activity: AR (links to VS-16) flag past-due; escalate per timeline (1–3 days: reminder; 7–15: notice; 30+: demand letter); Lease Credit Mgr outreach to customer, understand hardship, agree cure plan
For viable customers: Lease Credit Mgr offer restructure (extended term, lower payment, deferment); re-underwrite (links to W3163); Legal document amendment (links to W3172)

For non-curable default: Legal/Field Recovery execute remedies per contract — repossession of asset, demand full balance, file collection suit, report to credit bureau (where applicable); recover asset (links to W3175) and remarket (W3179)

fields.Participants: Lease Operations Mgr, Inspector, Quality, Customer, Inventory (links to VS-05)
fields.Trigger: Lease end-of-term with return option exercised

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "logistics guidance if returning" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "document with photos" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconcile to residual and post gain/loss" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-518 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Booking, Billing & Asset Lifecycle Management (PA-96.2).)
- operational: conservative residual (W3162) and strong remarketing (W3179)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Residual-realization risk**: Returned asset value below residual → loss; mitigated by conservative residual (W3162) and strong remarketing (W3179)
System Touchpoints: - Lease management system; inspection module; inventory/disposition (links to VS-05/VS-35); GL (links to VS-17)

steps.activity: Pre-maturity (90 days): Lease Operations Mgr contact customer re: end-of-term options (return/renew/buy-out — W3176); provide return logistics guidance if returning
On return: Inspector assess asset vs. end-of-lease condition standard (links to W3162 residual); identify excess wear/damage; compute customer charge for excess (per contract); document with photos

Disposition returned asset: remarket via used-equipment channel (W3179), refurbish (links to VS-09), redeploy to new lease, or scrap (links to VS-73/VS-35); reconcile to residual and post gain/loss (links to VS-17)

fields.Participants: Lease Operations Mgr, Finance, Legal, Customer
fields.Trigger: Customer elects buy-out, early termination, or renewal

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-communication of "communicate to customer with Truth-in-Lending-style disclosure" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-renew of "renewal" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: actuarially-sound formula and periodic recalibration
Pain Points / Risks: - **Buy-out-discount risk**: Below-market buy-out formula transfers value to customer; mitigated by actuarially-sound formula and periodic recalibration
System Touchpoints: - Lease accounting (links to VS-17); title/security release (links to VS-22/VS-35); new booking (links to W3169)

steps.activity: Lease Operations Mgr compute early-termination / buy-out quote per contract formula (typically: PV of remaining rentals + residual − unearned income − early-termination fee); communicate to customer with Truth-in-Lending-style disclosure

On customer acceptance: Finance process buy-out payment; transfer asset title to customer (release the chattel-mortgage registration / RA 11057 notation — W3168); book lease termination and gain/loss (links to VS-17)
For renewal: Lease Origination Mgr originate new/renewed lease per current rates (W3162) and credit (W3163); book new lease (W3169) and close prior lease; or convert to month-to-month per contract
steps.r: Lease Origination Mgr / Lease Operations Mgr
